known_facts.text: Building a payments ledger service. Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle. Frontend: TypeScript/React. Database: Postgres.
Uses GitLab merge requests with two approvals for all changes.
CI/CD pipeline built on GitLab CI.
Production releases require CAB approval.
Self-managed GitLab instance at gitlab.northwind.internal under the 'payments' group for source control.
Jira Data Center, an on-premise instance at jira.northwind.internal, with projects PAY and PLAT.
Uses an HTTP proxy for outbound connections, and if so, does it require authentication?
All outbound traffic goes through an authenticated corporate proxy at proxy.northwind.internal:18890, which also performs TLS inspection.
Uses internal mirrors for package registries or has air-gap constraints preventing external network access.
Uses a Nexus mirror for npm packages at nexus.northwind.internal/repository/npm-group/, with npmjs.org blocked and no inbound traffic from the internet.
Has compliance or data residency requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP, specific geographic regions)?
PCI-DSS compliant. All data and model traffic must stay within the EU.
Approximately 40 engineers, primarily located in London and Pune.
